summary: The SeAH Haiam Arts & Sciences Scholarship Foundation is holding the 1st Next-Generation Engineering Researchers Alumni Symposium 2026. Those wishing to attend must apply through the QR code on the attached poster by midnight on Sunday, 15 November 2026; applications may close earlier if the planned number is exceeded. The symposium takes place on Monday, 21 December 2026, from 15:00 to 17:00 in the 4th-floor Auditorium of SeAH Tower (Hapjeong Station).

translation:
1st Next-Generation Engineering Researchers Alumni Symposium 2026

1. The SeAH Haiam Arts & Sciences Scholarship Foundation is holding the "1st Next-Generation Engineering Researchers Alumni Symposium 2026" (제1회 차세대 공학연구자 Alumni 심포지엄 2026).

A. Application deadline: until midnight, Sunday, 15 November 2026
※ Even before the deadline, applications may close early if the number of applicants exceeds the planned number.

B. How to apply: Apply using the QR code on the poster.

C. Date and time: Monday, 21 December 2026, 15:00 to 17:00

D. Venue: 4th-floor Auditorium, SeAH Tower (Hapjeong Station)

E. Main programme:
- Lectures by foundation alumni researchers (materials, sensors, energy and AI)
- Panel discussion
- The foundation alumni homecoming day will follow immediately after the symposium.

Attachment (1): 홍보 포스터_1.jpg (promotional poster, 305 KB). The content of this image was not read and is not included in this translation.
